## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix comes with a test that fails before it)
- [ ] `scripts/ci-full-local.sh --quick` passes
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` (*Unreleased*) updated, if users will notice
- [ ] No private rules, keys, tokens, internal hostnames or paths (see CONTRIBUTING.md, "Privacy rules")
- [ ] Says so below if it changes rule identity, sids, export layout or release files
